provenance.note: the snare drier for the fast broken beat: the same shell, wires and crack, -10 dB at 55 ms where the snare's is 70, the shell gone in 80 ms and a third of its room; alone at the place it reads 43-50 ms to -12 dB where the snare read 52-65 (source 8's two-step, in the mix, 70-100); round DNB-4: tighter still — -10 dB at 35 ms, the shell gone in 50 ms, half that room again — since in the mix it carried the 800 Hz-3 kHz band 4 dB over source 8's two-step drops, its tail reading 104 ms where theirs read 70

notes.room: a third of the snare's: on a dry two-step the snare's room is the part a mix hears as wet
